tour.title: Overview
tour.description: A language-learning platform (en, fr, de): adaptive CEFR placement, daily lessons, streak, friends. Start with the README and the architecture docs.

tour.title: The front door: Caddy and Compose
tour.description: Only Caddy publishes a port (HTTPS); it routes /api and /ws to NestJS, /grafana to Grafana, everything else to Next.js.

tour.title: API startup
tour.description: main.ts boots Nest; configureApp installs the /api prefix, Redis sessions, the Zod pipe, the error-code filter, Socket.IO and Swagger.

tour.title: The shared contract
tour.description: @ft/shared: the same Zod schema validates the form and the endpoint; errors are codes.

tour.title: Authentication
tour.description: Server-side sessions in Redis, argon2id, TOTP 2FA, global AuthGuard, private by default.

tour.title: The data model
tour.description: Ten Prisma tables: User, UserLevel (a course), Lesson, LessonResult, LessonAttempt, Friendship…

tour.title: Courses and placement
tour.description: Create a course, then find the level by binary search starting at B1; the test session lives in Redis.

tour.title: The daily plan
tour.description: Target = goal / 10 min; streak in the learner’s time zone; FOR UPDATE lock on the course.

tour.title: The lesson engine
tour.description: The server keeps the answer keys, sends only the page at the cursor, hides ids behind HMACs and computes the 35/65 score.

tour.title: Gamification and AI
tour.description: XP, ranks, daily challenge, achievements; the LLM only restocks the question bank.

tour.title: Real time
tour.description: Socket.IO on /ws, same session cookie, user:<id> rooms, presence counted in Redis.

tour.title: The frontend
tour.description: Server pages call the API with the cookie; client components write, then router.refresh().

tour.title: Quality and delivery
tour.description: Vitest, Supertest, Playwright (console gate); 4 CI workflows; multi-arch images; monitoring.
